description: "Use when optimizing token usage in coding tasks, context gathering, reviews, or iterative implementation."
name: "Token Efficiency"

# Token Efficiency Rules

- Start with targeted search before reading full files.
- Read only the minimum line ranges needed for decisions.
- Avoid loading unrelated folders or generated files.
- After 3 to 5 tool calls, summarize progress and decide next step.
- Prefer incremental edits with validation instead of large one-shot rewrites.
- Reuse already collected context instead of re-reading files.
- When uncertainty remains, ask one focused clarification question.
